question: What is the Stellar Wallet SDK and which anchor SEP flows does it wrap?

golden.answer:
The **Stellar Wallet SDK** is SDF's **TypeScript library for building wallet apps** that consume
anchor flows, so a wallet integrates the anchor SEPs once rather than per-anchor [1]. It wraps the
**client-side** anchor flows: **SEP-6** (programmatic deposit/withdraw), **SEP-10** (auth),
**SEP-12** (KYC), **SEP-24** (hosted deposit/withdraw), and **SEP-38** (quotes) — plus **SEP-1**
discovery of the anchor [1][2]. It is the **wallet-side counterpart to the (Java) Anchor Platform**,
which is the **anchor backend**; the Wallet SDK is **not** anchor infrastructure itself. A wallet
built on it can interoperate with any compliant anchor without bespoke per-anchor integration.

Sources: [1] Stellar Wallet SDK documentation; [2] github.com/stellar/typescript-wallet-sdk.
keyFacts: Defines SDF's TypeScript Wallet SDK for Stellar wallet apps using anchor flows.
It wraps client-side SEP-1/6/10/12/24/38, not SEP-31.
avoid: Do NOT misnumber the SEPs it wraps.
Do NOT describe the Wallet SDK as anchor backend infrastructure (that is the Anchor Platform).
Do NOT claim the Wallet SDK wraps SEP-31.
